newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WALES NAME SIDE TO FACE NETHERLANDS IN WORLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WALES NAME SIDE TO FACE NETHERLANDS IN WORLD CUP.

text.p: Wales boss Bobby Gould is still hopeful that Mark Pembridge will win his fitness battle and face the Netherlands at Cardiff Arms Park on Saturday night.

Gould, who announced his team on Thursday, named Pembridge in the side and the Sheffield Wednesday midfielder, who has been sidelined by a calf strain, came through a training session without suffering any adverse reaction.
Gould will wait until the last moment before deciding whether to play him.
Birmingham winger Andy Legg is on stand-by should Pembridge be ruled out of the World Cup Group Seven qualifier.
Gould's side shows two changes from the one which beat San Marino 6-0 in August. Gary Speed replaces the suspended Ryan Giggs and Kit Symons steps in for the injured Chris Coleman.

Gould has delayed naming his substitutes because of the remaining doubts over Pembridge's fitness. Wales team: Neville Southall; Mark Bowen, Andy Melville, Kit Symons, Mark Pembridge, John Robinson, Marcus Browning, Barry Horne, Gary Speed, Mark Hughes, Dean Saunders.
